posts.title: Where Your Elements Came From
posts.lead: The hydrogen in your body and present in every molecule of water came from the Big Bang. There are no other appreciable sources of hydrogen in the universe.

posts.title: Fourth Balloon of NASA Scientific Balloon Campaign Launches
posts.lead: The BOOP! mission was launched on a scientific balloon from NASA’s launch facility in Fort Sumner, New Mexico, at 8:03 a.m. MDT (10:03 a.m. EDT) on Sept. 13, 2026.

posts.title: KMT-2025-BLG-0026L b
posts.lead: KMT-2025-BLG-0026L b is a gas giant exoplanet that orbits a Unknown-type star. Its mass is 2.13 Jupiters, it takes 1.4 years to complete one orbit of its star, and is 0.96 AU from its star. Its discovery was announced in 2026.
